sections.release_notes:
## :star: New Features

- Improve diagnostics in SpEL for `matches` operator [#30144](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30144)
- Improve diagnostics in SpEL for repeated text [#30142](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30142)
- Increase scope of regex pattern cache for the SpEL `matches` operator [#30140](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30140)
- Minor updates in HandlerMappingIntrospector [#30127](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30127)
- Skip parameter name resolution when not needed in `AbstractAutowireCapableBeanFactory` [#30103](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30103)
- Remove extra copy of headers/cookies in WebClient [#30092](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30092)
- Assert non-null arguments in `DefaultServerRequestBuilder` methods [#30046](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30046)
- Jetty 12 support in WebFlux [#29575](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29575)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Gradle task `processAot` fails when Bean Validation API present but no provider found [#30130](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30130)
- ContentDisposition::parse does not support Windows paths [#30111](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30111)
- BindException raised instead of MethodArgumentNotValidException subclass [#30100](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30100)
- Ensure reactive transaction rollback on commit error [#30096](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30096)
- CaffeineCacheManager getCache method cause thread block [#30066](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30066)
- RequestedContentTypeResolver does not ignore quality factor when filtering \*/\* media types [#29915](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29915)
- `@Autowired`/`@Value` does not work on inner bean in native [#29803](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29803)
- Avoid rollback after a commit failure in `TransactionalOperator` [#27572](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27572)
- SpEL: cannot call methods declared in `java.lang.Object` on a JDK proxy [#25316](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25316)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Add anchor rewrites in the reference documentation [#30132](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30132)
- Fix minor spacings in webflux docs [#30078](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30078)
- Add a list of observations produced by Spring Framework [#30060](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30060)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to Reactor 2022.0.5 [#30133](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30133)
